From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@stratusbank.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Cc: liam.oconnor@stratusbank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping request + two quick scope clarifications

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — StratusBank is excited about Redwood's latency and tenancy model. We’re starting the CAIQ review for a procurement kick-off and have a couple of scope clarifications before we dig into evidence. Could you confirm two items for us: 

1) Tenant scope: will Redwood consider our deployment (managed, single-tenant VPC) as in-scope for all CSA controls by default, or are there control families you treat as "customer-managed"? We want to know what to expect in the evidence bundle.

2) Key management: do you have a documented separation for KMS/HSM ownership in Private deployments? If so, can you point us at the artifact that proves the KMS rotation and access review cadence?

Can you also share a CAIQ/control crosswalk and an index of representative artifacts (logs, key rotation proofs, configuration snapshots) you expect to provide for an initial review?

We’re aiming to complete the first pass by Aug 6 to keep procurement timing.

Best,
Emily
Emily Hart
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | StratusBank

From: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@stratusbank.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + two quick scope clarifications

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick answers up front: 

- Tenant scope: For Redwood Private (single-tenant VPC) we own controls relating to the inference runtime, orchestration, and platform telemetry. Controls tied to customer-managed networking (e.g., customer firewall rules inside their VPC) and customer-side identity providers are considered customer-responsibility. We’ll call these out explicitly in the crosswalk.

- KMS/HSM: We operate an HSM-backed key wrapping flow in Private deployments when requested. We can provide the key-rotation log extract and the KMS access-review roster; those are part of our normal evidence package.

I’ve attached an initial CAIQ crosswalk (CAIQ_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) mapping high-level controls to Redwood artifacts and noting "owner: platform" vs "owner: customer" per control. I’ll follow up with an internal ask to get definitive artifact snapshots and a timeline for delivery.

Next steps I propose: 
1) We’ll produce an evidence index and deliver the first bundle by Aug 4.
2) Kimberly (cc’d) will pick up the KMS artifacts and log extracts.
3) Marissa will coordinate the bundle upload to a secure ShareFile link and send you access.

If that aligns, we’ll start the artifact pull today.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
